assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have transformed precision measurement, reaching a regime in which new tests and applications become practical.
assessment.attribution: Katori originated the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept, while Ye made decisive experimental advances and established its broad metrological power.
assessment.maturity: The precision, reproducibility, and international uptake are exceptional after sustained experimental validation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Aberration correction made electron microscopy a substantially more powerful instrument for observing matter atom by atom.
assessment.attribution: Rose supplied essential theoretical foundations; Haider and Krivanek delivered distinct, highly influential practical correction systems.
assessment.maturity: Its performance and impact across microscopy, materials science, and nanoscience are long established.
uncertainties: The technical lineage has many important contributors beyond the three named.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atom interferometry created a powerful route to inertial sensing and fundamental measurements using coherent matter waves.
assessment.attribution: Bordé provided foundational atom-optics concepts, and Kasevich made landmark interferometric demonstrations and sensing methods.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been repeatedly validated and now support a broad precision-measurement field.
uncertainties: The appropriate division of credit among the field's early experimental and theoretical contributors remains difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Squeezed light converts a fundamental quantum-optical resource into demonstrable sensitivity beyond conventional quantum noise limits.
assessment.attribution: Caves established the central quantum-measurement insight; Mavalvala and Schnabel made major experimental and interferometric contributions.
assessment.maturity: Routine use in major precision interferometers gives this work compelling experimental maturity.
uncertainties: Attribution overlaps with the broader development of gravitational-wave interferometry and quantum optics.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum cascade laser was a genuinely new semiconductor-laser principle, opening coherent mid-infrared and terahertz technologies.
assessment.attribution: Capasso's band-structure engineering was central to the concept, and Faist was central to its experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The technology has endured for decades and enabled spectroscopy, sensing, and industrial instruments.
uncertainties: The contribution of other Bell Labs collaborators requires careful historical accounting.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Titanium-sapphire and practical passive mode locking made robust femtosecond lasers widely available, enabling much of modern ultrafast science.
assessment.attribution: Moulton's laser medium and the passive-mode-locking advances associated with Keller and Sibbett form a coherent instrumental contribution.
assessment.maturity: The experimental platform is exceptionally mature and has enabled generations of measurements.
uncertainties: The broad history of femtosecond-laser development makes a three-person attribution restrictive.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antimatter trapping and precision spectroscopy offer unusually clean tests of matter-antimatter symmetry and fundamental physics.
assessment.attribution: Gabrielse pioneered precision work with trapped antiparticles, while Hangst led decisive antihydrogen trapping and measurement programs.
assessment.maturity: The experiments are technically demanding but have advanced from proof of principle to increasingly quantitative tests.
uncertainties: Whether present measurement precision has yet delivered a sufficiently decisive fundamental result is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recollision picture supplied the intelligible physical basis for high-harmonic generation and attosecond methods.
assessment.attribution: Corkum and Lewenstein gave central and complementary formulations of the three-step and strong-field framework.
assessment.maturity: The model has been extensively tested and underlies a mature experimental field.
uncertainties: The relationship to already recognized attosecond-science advances and the credit due to other theorists need close consideration.
